notes: Recovered a prior day's (2026-11-15) commit that existed only on a detached HEAD and had not reached origin/master; fast-forwarded master to include it before this run.
Scopus volume 394 (coverDate 2026-12-15) contains 16 total entries; 13 were already captured in prior runs as Articles-in-Press, leaving only 3 genuinely new entries today.

PubMed ESearch (reldate=730d) returned 677 pmids not yet in seen_articles.json by pmid key, but cross-referencing by DOI against existing doi: keys in seen_articles.json showed nearly all were duplicates of already-processed papers (same paper, different identifier). Only 3 PubMed-sourced candidates passed DOI dedup, and all 3 were excluded under the microbe-centric or non-research-article (expression of concern) rules.

Elsevier API key used here only has metadata search access, not abstract full-text access (AUTHORIZATION_ERROR on abstract view=FULL). Combined with the 3 new papers being extremely recently published (ahead of their Dec 2026 formal issue date), no abstract text could be retrieved via PubMed, Semantic Scholar, CrossRef, or WebSearch for 2 of 3 papers.
